mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO jutsu_film ( slug, film_index, label, relative_url, paywalled, discovered_at, last_seen_at ) VALUES
(#{f.slug}, #{f.filmIndex}, #{f.label}, #{f.relativeUrl}, #{f.paywalled}, #{f.discoveredAt}, #{f.lastSeenAt})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE label = VALUES(label), relative_url = VALUES(relative_url), paywalled = COALESCE(VALUES(paywalled), paywalled), discovered_at = COALESCE(discovered_at, VALUES(discovered_at)), last_seen_at = VALUES(last_seen_at)
